sources.observation: Trimming uses Unicode White_Space, including NEL and excluding BOM.
ASCII case comparison preserves non-ASCII values.
Results distinguish Ok from Err and retain the associated payload.
Rust string continuation escapes remove the following ASCII whitespace.
CRLF input normalizes to LF before literal interpretation.
while evaluates its condition before each iteration; unlabelled break and continue affect the innermost loop.
Primitive scalar compound assignment performs the corresponding checked integer arithmetic and stores the result.
Indexing a slice outside its bounds panics.

verification: Node/Bun executable fixture outcomes and strict TypeScript checks; no local Rust compilation. Expected Rust outcomes follow these documented contracts and independently authored literals.
